verdict.rationale: Zep builds a Context Graph of entities and relationships from chat/data (zep-docs-27, zep-docs-2), supports custom entity/edge types (zep-docs-3/33), temporal fact tracking via Graphiti (zep-gh-1/2/3, zep-docs-43), and hybrid semantic+BM25 graph search with dynamic composition across edges/nodes for multi-hop context (zep-docs-9,10,22). Community evidence shows Zep explicitly moved to a knowledge-graph approach (Graphiti) to fix recall/hallucination issues in fact-based memory (zep-comm-3), corroborating real-world entity-centric reasoning support. Missing for 10: independent benchmark or third-party validation of actual multi-hop query accuracy beyond vendor docs.
